description: This file defines the StatusFragment class, which is responsible for displaying user and friend status updates within the Android app. The fragment inflates a layout, initializes a list view, and populates it with sample status data.

classes.name: StatusFragment
classes.description: A Fragment for viewing user and friends' status updates. It inflates a layout, sets up a ListView, and populates it with sample statuses.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's onCreateView to create and initialize the status list UI, inflating the layout and setting list data.
